sourceQuote: After graduation you can be comprehensive senior engineers to design mechatronics system, do manufacture or develop new technology in the enterprises or research institute. You can also go to university to make search in the major.
targetQuote: 毕业后，您可担任综合高级工程师，负责机电系统设计，或在企业或研究院从事制造或新技术研发。您也可以到大学继续对本专业进行深入研究。
